What changed in this PR This PR fixes #8663 by allowing the MISP feed connector to process attributes without an optional `comment`, preventing event failures and dropped indicators or observables. **Changes:** - Default missing or null comments to an empty string without modifying the original attribute. - Add regression tests for comment-free `ip-dst`, `yara`, and `sigma` attributes. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `external-import/​misp-feed/​tests/​tests_connector/​test_connector.py` | Adds parametrized tests asserting indicator creation without comments. | | `external-import/​misp-feed/​src/​connector/​connector.py` | Normalizes optional comments before attribute conversion. |

review_comments.body: Give this fixture an explicit, deterministic identity ID. This constructor currently lets `stix2` generate a random ID, contrary to `AGENTS.md:61–65`; the repository's STIX ID checker also flags domain-object constructors without an `id`. A fixed valid identity ID is sufficient for this test.
